title: Water: Ice, Liquid and Steam
summary: Melting, freezing, evaporation and condensation, and the water cycle.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 1: Water — The Essence of Life

objectives: I can name the three states of water.
I can describe melting, freezing, evaporation and condensation.
I can explain the water cycle.
misconceptions: Steam and the white cloud from a kettle are the same thing.
Clouds are made of smoke or cotton.
